release_notes:
1. Group Header Titles Typography: Fixed 'Cart & Checkout' double HTML entity escaping in the advertising event routing interface so it consistently renders as 'Cart & Checkout'.
2. Digital Marketing Industry Standard Group Naming: Prevented PrestaShop's core translation engine from translating 'Conversion' to the German currency term 'Umwandlung', ensuring standardized marketing terminology ('Product Discovery', 'Cart & Checkout', 'Conversion') across all store languages.
